chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Marwak ibn Ubayd, from his father Ubayd, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Ubayd! Extravagance begets poverty, and moderation begets wealth.'
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between spending habits and wealth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a causal link between financial behavior and economic stability, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *Qasd* (moderation) as a spiritual and practical virtue. It serves as a foundational principle in Islamic ethics, warning against *Israf* (extravagance) not merely as a moral failing but as a direct cause of material scarcity, while advocating for balanced expenditure as a means to achieve lasting sufficiency.
